text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Heeey☆ Been waiting long? Wobbly~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah! ...Haha. Not bad. You're hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! Alright, here we go...

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh!? Amazing! Ooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha♪ Pretty good, right? Booyah☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Two weeks remain until the Seitei Festival—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous & Bono
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuus☆★☆ Booooono♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Good work. How is the progress?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, as you can see—going extremely well! Just as you scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl C
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Ah, like this! Hehe, I’m finally getting confident!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Everyone’s mindset has changed. The atmosphere too. At this rate, there shouldn’t be any problems for the upcoming performance showcase.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, I agree. So next—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I can’t catch even one!!! I’m seriously at my limit here~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That’s only natural. You’re attempting to juggle five clubs—it’s a whole different level of difficulty from three.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah... weird, right? It’s just two more, isn’t it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If I may suggest—perhaps you should perform with three clubs for the show. It’s something you’ve already mastered.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: At your current success rate, you might not complete it before the deadline. And you also have other acts to prepare for.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: To avoid overexertion, lowering the difficulty might be the best choice for you and the team.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nah... I’m not lowering it. That’d be pointless—it’s gotta be hard, or it’s not worth it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I’ll keep at it a bit more. Just watch me a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (...2 days and 16 hours remain until the showcase. At this rate, Jordan alone will...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...? There’s light coming from the library...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Flash! Heeey. Hype—haaah~...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Jordan? Why are you here at this hour...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Can’t you tell? I’m studying. Seriously don’t wanna though. Reading’s such a pain, ugh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But you know, the circus guy recommended a book. Thought I could get some hints, maybe...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I see. Still, you shouldn’t push yourself too hard, or you’ll get sick.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Exactly! Just looking at words makes me feel that way! So study time’s over! Next up—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: When throwing, focus on the wrist... guh! Damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What I meant to say was, you’ve been active for over seven hours today. You should be resting now...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But listen, Flash! You saw that, right? I did it for a second! I’m getting it! The timing of the throws! Alright! I’m gonna nail this for real!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I thought I understood... but you really are serious.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ’Cause it’s lame to quit just ’cause it’s hard.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whether I can do it or not doesn’t matter. I’m done using clumsiness as an excuse to give up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So I’ll do it. Juggling. Even if I can’t yet—until I can.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Besides, juggling five instead of three looks way cooler! Fans will be shocked for sure!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So yeah, just watch. I’m gonna light up the floor.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Tell me, how many more days do you need to be absolutely sure you can juggle five?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I plan to make it in time, but... if I had a week, I could totally do it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Understood. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Seitei Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: You’re asking to delay the showcase by one week...? May I ask the reason?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. Because with that extra time, we can deliver the performance we’re aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (I remember now... why my younger self was so excited at Fastnacht—the carnival.)

text_block_list.name: Young Flash
text_block_list.text: Wow! Look, Dad! Mom!! Such a big float! Everyone’s pulling it together!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (It was beyond what I imagined. The town was decorated, the parade filled the streets with song, and everyone smiled—so that means...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (Our circus needs to do the same. The place Jordan aims for without running away—that’s our goal too.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: We already have something convincing to show. But to reach an even higher goal, I would like to ask for more time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Please, I’m asking for your approval.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then, one week later—

text_block_list.name: Seitei Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: Th-the results are in! This time, your circus performance...

text_block_list.name: Seitei Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: Has been approved for the event!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Maaaarvelouuuus☆★☆ We did iiiit♪

text_block_list.name: Seitei Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: A perfect number of participants, an amazing performance! Most of all, the teachers said they’ll fully support your passion!

text_block_list.name: Seitei Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: The academy will also contact professionals for the venue setup! Now we can hold it safely and perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Heheh. Heheheh. Heeey☆ Come on, Flash, join in!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hee—...ahem. We’ve come this far. Now let’s give it our all on stage.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ’Course! Let’s make it a hype circus!
